name: Indonesian phone
description: Indonesian mobile numbers using the 08 or 62 country-code formats.

name: Philippine Phone
description: Philippine mobile numbers using 09, +63, 63, or 0063 formats.

name: Indonesian NIK/KTP number
description: Sixteen-digit Indonesian identity numbers with a valid encoded birth day and month.

name: Philippine TIN
description: Philippine tax identification numbers in 9-digit or grouped 12-digit form.

name: Philippine SSS number
description: Philippine Social Security System numbers in plain or grouped form.

name: PhilHealth number
description: PhilHealth identification numbers in the standard grouped format.

name: Pag-IBIG MID number
description: Pag-IBIG membership identification numbers in grouped format.

name: Long number (first 10 digits)
description: Masks the first ten digits of any otherwise unmatched run of ten or more digits.
